description: Current FinOps spend SLO posture (gev-finops-slo-* and meridian-slo-*). errorBudgetRemaining < 0 means violated. Daily ceilings: org $3k, stage $2k, monitoring $900, ESF $800, Agent Builder 10M tokens.

configuration.query:
FROM .slo-observability.summary-v3.6
| WHERE slo.id LIKE "gev-finops-slo-*" OR slo.id LIKE "meridian-slo-*"
| KEEP slo.id, slo.name, errorBudgetRemaining, errorBudgetConsumed, latestSliTimestamp
| EVAL violated = errorBudgetRemaining < 0
| SORT slo.name
